excellent surgery with the usual problems of the NHS.  A good team of doctors, nurses, paramedics and othe specialist services.
Doctors used to be time conscious, but now find that, for patients with complicated health issues, the doctors find the time to discuss issues and associated concerns.

Receptionist get a lot of complaints, but I've never had any problems.   I can understand their difficulties, having witnessed the expectations some patients have.  GPs time is limited and for many people, a visit to one of the villages two pharmacies will quickly solve their problems.

But nobody's perfect and there's more that the surgery could do.
The newsletter gives very little information on 'news at the Surgery' such as staff changes, etc.

Repeated messages when telephoning can be annoying because of their length and frequency.

Not sure if there is a call back function if you are in a queue.

Usually, there is ample parking adjacent to the surgery, but do take a ticket from the machine. First 30 minutes is free (not if you use the app - it doesn't recognise the free time!)

10th Jan 2026
